card.name: Drug named before route of injection
card.fires_on: The drug, dose or injection word just before the route is given (subcutaneously, intramuscularly, intravenously), mainly in administration instructions. Also fires on the start of the route word itself, such as 'intr' before 'amuscularly'.

modes.label: Drug or dose before route
modes.description: A drug name, dose or the word injection or administered, right before the route of injection.

modes.label: Start of route word
modes.description: The opening piece of intramuscular or intravenous, just before the rest of the word.
